name: clone-error-message-data-descriptor-and-order
source: let calls=0;const e=new TypeError();Object.defineProperty(e,'stack',{value:'fixed',writable:true,configurable:true});Object.defineProperty(e,'message',{get(){calls++;throw new Error('not called')},configurable:true});const a=structuredClone(e);record([a instanceof TypeError,Object.hasOwn(a,'message'),a.message,calls].join(','));const p=new Error();Object.setPrototypeOf(p,{name:'RangeError',message:'inherited'});const b=structuredClone(p);record([b instanceof RangeError,Object.hasOwn(b,'message'),b.message].join(','));const n=new Error();Object.defineProperty(n,'message',{value:{toString(){calls++;return 'converted'}},configurable:true});const c=structuredClone(n);record(c.message);const d=new Error('old');Object.defineProperty(d,'name',{get(){Object.defineProperty(d,'message',{value:'new'});return 'TypeError'}});record(structuredClone(d).message);record(calls);const bad=new Error();Object.defineProperty(bad,'message',{value:Symbol(),configurable:true});try{structuredClone(bad)}catch(e){record(e.name)}
nativeDifference: Chromium does not preserve the specified name-getter-before-message-descriptor effect. HTML StructuredSerializeInternal 17.1 precedes 17.3, so the name getter's message mutation must be observed.
